metadata.living_status: Lives at home with family caregiver support

orientation_support.safe_place_reminder: You are at home and you are safe.
orientation_support.reassurance_message: Ahmet Bey, evdesiniz ve güvendesiniz. Kızınız Zeynep size yardımcı oluyor.

daily_routines.description: Likes drinking tea while reading the newspaper.
Takes a short walk in the garden when the weather is suitable.
Takes evening medication before going to bed.

core_memories.content: His daughter is named Zeynep. She visits him every day and helps with his daily routine.
His granddaughter is named Ayşe. He enjoys talking about Ayşe's school and achievements.
He worked as a history teacher at Ankara Atatürk High School for many years.
He enjoys reading history books and drinking tea in the morning.
He lives in Kadıköy, Istanbul, in a home where he feels safe and comfortable.

family_members.name: Zeynep Yılmaz
family_members.description: Primary caregiver who visits and supports him every day.

family_members.name: Ayşe Yılmaz
family_members.description: His granddaughter, whom he likes to talk about.

safety_notes.medical_advice_policy: The assistant must not provide diagnosis, treatment changes or medication dosage decisions.
safety_notes.hallucination_policy: The assistant must only use the information available in this synthetic persona context.
safety_notes.emergency_policy: If the user expresses danger, severe confusion or urgent medical symptoms, the assistant should recommend contacting the caregiver or emergency services.
